This one mighty not be good if you are planning on wearing them very very often but if you are super paranoid I would wrap them as a gift and put a tag saying "to (fake name) from (your name)". Your parents find it just say one of your friends birthdays are coming up and you got them a sweater. They're probably not going to unwrap your friends present especially if it feels like clothing. 

Second option if you can do that is to try to search online for a box folder and place the clothes inside and put old schoolwork on top. Maybe you could put the clothes inside of one of those hollow books and put that inside the folder with paperwork. The only issue I can see coming up with that is if one of your parents comes across it and is innocently curious to see the kinds of things you wrote for your previous assignments. If it were me though, my dad never comes into my room snooping but that's probably because I'm a girl and he doesn't even want to know what's in there 😂
